# Grim Anticheat (optional third-party)

Official **Grim AC** Bukkit/Folia plugin for heavy movement/packet anti-cheat.

| | |
|--|--|
| License | **GNU GPLv3** |
| Upstream | https://github.com/GrimAnticheat/Grim |
| Download | https://modrinth.com/plugin/grimac (recommended) |
| Install | `./scripts/fetch-grim.sh` → `plugins/grim.jar` |

YaPcore does **not** vendor this jar in git (same policy as Tebex / Folia). Use
`fetch-grim.sh` before release zips if you ship optional AC.

Setup: [docs/ops/GRIM.md](../../docs/ops/GRIM.md) · Strategy: [docs/ops/ANTICHEAT.md](../../docs/ops/ANTICHEAT.md)
